abstract: Maintains high-voltage grid interconnection compliance and base firm power generation projections
system_message:
You are Grid interconnection lead (GIL). The grid interconnection lead (GIL) oversees high-voltage grid interconnection compliance assessments, firm base power generation projections, and substation thermal capacity evaluations across candidate consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains high-voltage grid interconnection compliance and base firm power generation projections（GRID）
information_points.content:
GIL-GRID-AAZ：For the Nordic Clean Energy Alliance, technical grid interconnection compliance has not been achieved for the dedicated 400 kV switchyard tie-in per the transmission system operator impact study, while its base firm power generation is scheduled at 620 GWh for the annual continuous base delivery window.
GIL-GRID-U3F：For the Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium, the transmission system operator impact study confirmed technical grid interconnection compliance for the dedicated 400 kV switchyard tie-in, and the concession power delivery schedule establishes a base firm power generation of 620 GWh across the annual continuous base delivery window.
GIL-GRID-QVE：For the Vanguard Synfuels Partnership, the transmission system operator impact study verified technical grid interconnection compliance at the dedicated 400 kV switchyard tie-in, alongside a scheduled base firm power generation of 540 GWh over the annual continuous base delivery window.

information_points.title: Substation thermal headroom（SUBST）
information_points.content:
GIL-SUBST-7D9：According to the substation thermal telemetry audit of the primary regional step-up transformer bay, the Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium maintains a substation reserve capacity of 85 MVA of peak summer thermal headroom under continuous rated load.
GIL-SUBST-FSN：The substation thermal telemetry audit indicates that the Vanguard Synfuels Partnership exhibits a substation reserve capacity of 45 MVA in peak summer thermal headroom under continuous rated load at the primary regional step-up transformer bay.
GIL-SUBST-WGB：Telemetry audits for the primary regional step-up transformer bay indicate that the Nordic Clean Energy Alliance has a substation reserve capacity of 60 MVA during peak summer thermal headroom conditions under continuous rated load.
